name: Computational Experiment Input
abstract: OGC API Records profile for describing a single input artefact consumed by a computational experiment. Carries the role of the input (AOI, feature-of-interest geometry, baseline, coefficient, …), an optional binding to an equation symbol carried by an `equation-property-relationship` instance, the source URI, format and vocabulary term, and the CWL input name that the input is bound to. Designed to be referenced by an `experiment` record so that one input definition can be reused across runs.
